# AIVS (AI Vending Solution Pte. Ltd.), vending machines you can own, Singapore

> AI Vending Solution Pte. Ltd. (AIVS, UEN 202439764G, incorporated 27 September 2024) sells refurbished self-service vending machines to owner-operators in Singapore and places them in malls, Changi Airport and motorcycle shops. Two machines: AI Printbox, which prints a custom phone case in about 3 minutes (customers pay S$15; machine from S$5,000 with a 1-year hardware warranty), and Topi Express, which disinfects, deodorises and sterilises a motorcycle helmet in about 5 minutes (customers pay S$5; machine from S$1,800 with a 6-month hardware warranty). Owners pay 0% royalties, buy stock at cost price, get free training, 24/7 technical support, an optional support plan from S$99 a month and a live sales dashboard. 19 machines are live: 13 AI Printbox (AMK Hub, Bukit Panjang Plaza, Changi Airport T3 Arrival Hall and B2, Changi City Point, City Square Mall, Eastpoint Mall, Hillion Mall, Hougang Mall, Parkway Parade, Sembawang Shopping Centre, Tampines 1, The Centrepoint) and 6 Topi Express (Wheels & Cycles Woodlands, 345 Wash Telok Blangah, Candy Motor, Gusto Broz Workshop and Hodaka Motoworld in Kaki Bukit, BW Motorsports Old Toh Tuck Road). Office: 60 Jalan Lam Huat, #05-54, Carros Centre, Singapore 737869. WhatsApp +65 8335 4865 (machine purchase and business collaboration), +65 8878 4061 (technical support and refunds), info@aivs.sg. "AI" in the name stands for Automated Intelligence, not artificial intelligence.
